# ghost/notally-notes

Notally (F-Droid): a minimalist local notes app. Create notes with a title and body, list them, read one and delete one. Offline, no account, nothing leaves the phone.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/notally-notes
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/notally-notes open_notes --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/notally-notes create_note --device <serial> --param title=<title>
ghost skill run ghost/notally-notes list_notes --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/notally-notes read_note --device <serial> --param title=<title>
ghost skill run ghost/notally-notes delete_note --device <serial> --param title=<title> --param confirm=<confirm>
```

## Actions

- `open_notes`: Open my Notally notes
- `create_note`: Create a note called Shopping idea saying Buy milk
- `list_notes`: What notes do I have?
- `read_note`: Read my note Shopping idea
- `delete_note`: Delete my note Shopping idea
